changelog: The Lending, tuned: the ring-5 areas pay what their ranges promise, the Frostfair and Vigil bosses and the Reedlight's mobs are calibrated against the simulators, the hint names people by a word you can type and shows five side quests, and Brann no longer meets Corm twice.
The Lending: Aldric borrowed a flame from six places fifty years ago. Three old areas grow doors (the Hospice, the Reedlight, the Lampwrights' Deep) and the Court's beacon is answered from the west.
The Frostfair and the Vigil: two ring-5 areas (Legendary to Godlike gear), each with a rolled boss who ends in release, a mini-boss, damage fields, and an annex that opens when the beacon is lit.
The Third Quench: six receipts, Aldric's letter, two Given Flames and the two smiths together make the Godlike recipe. A Godlike forging now takes both anvils.
The Long Quench: a week at the anvil for a Godlike weapon (x2.0 to x3.0 damage, never destroys, odds shown first).
The apex spell is reachable: the Sixfold Chart, Hearts, the Grand Binding and apex heat.
Forge prices retuned so a Godlike is a goal, not a fantasy. The level cap stays 12.
A Darkness Dealer in ring 5 (Legendary gear is now more likely than not), moving from the Frostfair to the Vigil as they are lit.
Ysolde's Roll of Lenders: ask the Wizard where every door of the Lending is. New gem codes for the new places.

The Roll of Lenders keeps telling you where a receipt lies after its door is open (the Scriptorium, the Keeper's Cottage, the Rack Room, the Lending Tent, the Chart Library), and says when the Court's receipt is not yet Pell's to give.
Old saves load: every new room gets its floor items.
The Darkness Dealers (one per ring, new seat each day, only in the dark): fair gear, cursed bargains and relics for gems, never Godlike.
The `update` command: check, show what's new, back up saves, install safely; recovers from a power cut mid-install.
The Ember Court: a 13-room burned noble house beyond the North Gate (after the story), with its own enemies, a Steward, a Queen, an outpost and a beacon.
Boss power rolls: the Cinder Queen rolls 1 to 100 each time you enter; see it first, step back or run for free, mercy after two deaths.
New lock: an element door that needs a Water or Ice book equipped. Lighting a beacon lights the whole area.
Tamsin the smith: move her to Hollowmere and the forge runs a second job at once.
Spells: six elements, spell books, the Magician's tower (equip, craft, buy, combine), enemy weaknesses and resistances.
Books combine by chance with the odds shown first; a recipe log records discoveries.
Spell keys S1, S2... in a fight; the `spells` command.
The forge: raise Rare gear and relics to Epic, Ultra, Legendary and Godlike, with odds, heat, loaner weapons and the colour-sweep reveal.
Relics and sockets. Hollow Cores drop from every boss.
Power curve calibrated by simulation.
Hollowmere grows: home and stash, Market Row, a Builder, three residents who pay rent.
Dread: fear makes you hit harder and get hit harder.
Homecoming Charm: recall home, return to where you rested.
Gems and codes (try: redeem NEW). First boss kills give gems.
The world stays open after the story. The Wizard's Shop can call back bosses or rewind the story.
Item rarity names and symbols. Hesk's practice fight. Objective line, hint, travel, labelled maps.
